biotools.summary: zFISHer is an open-source application designed for automated, end-to-end analysis of sequential multiplexed Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization (FISH) images. It provides 3D registration, puncta detection, and colocalization analysis, complemented by interactive user-curation tools.
